title: Weakening an execution postcondition
statement: Let $s$ be a statement, $\sigma$ an initial state, $T_1\le T$ natural-number cost bounds, and $R,Q$ state predicates. If $s$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $R$, and every state satisfying $R$ also satisfies $Q$, then $s$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: An execution of $s$ from $\sigma$ ends in a state satisfying $R$ with cost at most $T_1$
